name: communication_step_mismatch_warns
description: T (the controller's own sample time, used directly in the integral and derivative formulas) is set to 0.02 here while the scenario's communication step_size is 0.01. pid_fmi2.c checks for exactly this mismatch in fmi2DoStep and reports it through the FMU's own logger every step -- run with --debug-logging (CLI) or inspect report.json's fmu_log/summary.log_warnings after running to see it. This is not a bug in the controller; it is the wrapper catching a configuration mistake the way a real exported model should. Verified: 10 warnings for 10 steps.

metadata.derived_from: src/pid_fmi2.c fmi2DoStep, the T/communicationStepSize consistency check
metadata.author: Claude (Sonnet 5), reading the source directly

checks.description: A loose sanity bound; the point of this scenario is fmu_log, not this check.
